python.label: Python
python.indexing: AST definitions, imports, calls, decorators, and routes
python.relationship_analysis: Resolved call graph with optional LSP and SCIP precision
python.security_analysis: AST taint with assignment, interpolation, call, and sanitizer tracking
python.limitations: Dynamic imports, monkey patching, and runtime dependency injection can require manual review.

javascript.label: JavaScript
javascript.indexing: Token-aware structural extraction with import and call edges
javascript.relationship_analysis: Static graph plus optional LSP and SCIP precision
javascript.security_analysis: Pattern-based taint fallback for common source-to-sink shapes
javascript.limitations: The committed corpus has positive cases but no JavaScript negative control yet.

typescript.label: TypeScript
typescript.indexing: Token-aware functions, classes, types, imports, calls, and routes
typescript.relationship_analysis: Static graph plus optional LSP and SCIP precision
typescript.security_analysis: Pattern-based taint fallback for common source-to-sink shapes
typescript.limitations: Generated clients, path aliases, and dynamic framework wiring may need LSP, SCIP, or manual review.

vue.label: Vue
vue.indexing: SFC script and template-aware component, import, and API-call extraction

vue.security_analysis: JavaScript and TypeScript pattern fallback inside extracted scripts
vue.limitations: No committed standalone Vue accuracy corpus is claimed.
